stories.story_fr: L'adoption du hybrid bonding a progresse a plus de 150 commandes cumulees aupres de 18 clients, et les premieres lignes de production integrees de hybrid bonding ont ete installees.
stories.story_en: Hybrid bonding adoption grew to 150+ cumulative orders and 18 customers, and the first integrated hybrid bonding production lines were installed.
stories.quote: Hybrid bonding adoption grew to 150+ cumulative orders and 18 customers

stories.story_fr: Les commandes de systemes de hybrid bonding ont commence a augmenter a partir du T4 2025, signalant le demarrage du cycle de montee en puissance pour l'assemblage avance.
stories.story_en: Orders for hybrid bonding systems started increasing from Q4-25, signalling the beginning of the ramp for advanced packaging.
stories.signal: Reprise des commandes hybrid bonding au T4-25
stories.quote: Increased orders for hybrid bonding systems starting in Q4-25

stories.story_fr: L'adoption du thermo-compression bonder TC Next s'est elargie a 5 clients et a plusieurs marches finaux, completant l'offre hybrid bonding pour les applications IA de nouvelle generation.
stories.story_en: TC Next thermo-compression bonder adoption expanded to 5 customers and multiple end markets, complementing the hybrid bonding offering for next-gen AI applications.
stories.quote: TC Next adoption expanded to 5 customers and multiple end markets

stories.story_fr: De nouveaux cas d'usage ont ete identifies pour les composants ASIC et l'optique co-packagee (CPO), NVIDIA confirmant l'adoption du hybrid bonding dans ses commutateurs CPO.
stories.story_en: New use cases were identified for ASIC devices and co-packaged optics (CPO), with NVIDIA confirming hybrid bonding adoption in its CPO switches.
stories.quote: New use cases identified for ASIC devices and co packaged optics

stories.story_fr: Un nouveau systeme prototype de hybrid bonding a ete acheve avec une precision de 50 nm et un debit accru, renforcant l'avance technologique de Besi pour l'empilement 3D de chiplets.
stories.story_en: A new hybrid bonding prototype system was completed with 50nm accuracy and increased throughput, strengthening Besi's technology lead for 3D chiplet stacking.
stories.quote: New hybrid prototype system completed with 50nm accuracy and increased throughput
